initializeCommand: bash -c 'source /usr/local/share/nvm/nvm.sh && nvm install 8.12.0 && nvm use 8.12.0 && npm install -g @angular/cli@1.7.4'
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'if [ -d "my-angular5-app" ]; then cd my-angular5-app && npm install; else ng new my-angular5-app --skip-git --skip-install && cd my-angular5-app && npm install; fi'
